title: Minimum Initial Strength to Defeat All Monsters
summary: Fight monsters in input order with nonnegative initial strength. Inclusive range boosts add temporary bonuses during the eligibility check only. Defeat monster i when current strength plus applicable boosts is at least its strength; afterward set current strength to max(0,current-monster strength). Return the least initial strength that defeats all monsters. Bonuses never replenish persistent strength.
officialConstraints: 1..50000 monsters, strengths1..10^9; 0..50000 valid boost ranges with positive boost values<=10^9.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
